# Tile quantity calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/tile-calculator/

Estimate tiles, boxes and material cost for an area with a waste allowance. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Cover 20 m² using 60 × 60 cm tiles, a 10% allowance and four tiles per box.

## Limits and checks

This estimates area coverage and does not lay out individual cuts, grout widths or patterned arrangements. Buy according to the actual project.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
